item.title: Politics / Excerpt Selections from an anthology of writing on and by Umar Khalid “Partly, this book also emerges from our habit of gathering books for Umar to read while he is ‘inside’ (because the one thing he has more than us is time),” the editors note in their introduction. “Partly, it is also to see his incarceration as a lens through which we attempt to understand the time that we are all living through.” Shuddhabrata Sengupta , Banojyotsna Lahiri , Anirban Bhattacharya
